registry_policy.weight_policy: Git stores manifests, parameters, metrics, provenance, and SHA-256 checksums. Multi-gigabyte model weights remain in persistent artifact storage.

usage.MCF: Use all five fold-specific checkpoints for the controlled five-fold paper result. Fold 2 is only the best single demonstration checkpoint for fold 2.
usage.TOFU: Use the saved Forget05 seed-42 checkpoint only for the recorded local probability protocol until full tofu_eval is stored separately.
usage.ZsRE: Use the saved calibration-384 seed-1 checkpoint only for seed-1 reproduction. Train/repair a separate checkpoint for each other official seed.
